title: 12か月の誕生花
subject_en: One representative birth flower per month, each a separate single flower with a short stem and leaves, clean line-and-colour style. Outlines are closed thin dark-navy lines all around every petal and leaf; light petals are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or pale tinted, never pure white. No letters or numbers.
lead: 1月の水仙から12月のポインセチアまで、月ごとの誕生花を1輪ずつ。誕生日カード、お誕生日の掲示、月のおたよりの飾りに使える12点。
items: a narcissus (daffodil) flower, cream petals with a yellow cup, on a stem with two leaves
a short plum branch with three pink blossoms and a bud
a single red tulip with two leaves
a small cherry blossom sprig with three pale pink flowers
a lily-of-the-valley stem with cream bell flowers and two leaves
a round blue hydrangea head with two leaves
a single white lily, cream petals, on a stem with a bud
a single sunflower with a brown centre and two leaves
a gentian stem with several blue-violet flowers
two pink cosmos flowers on thin stems
a yellow chrysanthemum with a short stem and leaves
a red poinsettia with green lower leaves
